_provenance.note: semantics with no machine source; kept small. The top-level lists use 1.13+ flattened identifiers. The pre_flattening block mirrors them under the identifiers the 1.8-1.12.2 registries actually use, and REPLACES them on those bands, because three of these names denote a different block in each era: pre-1.13 minecraft:grass is the grass BLOCK (not the short plant, which is minecraft:tallgrass) and minecraft:snow is the snow BLOCK (not the layer, which is minecraft:snow_layer). Marking those two replaceable, which is what the unscoped list did on protocols 107-340, tells a caller a solid block can be built over. Materials verified in MCP 1.8.9 Material.java: Material.vine and Material.snow call setReplaceable(); BlockTallGrass/BlockDeadBush/BlockDoublePlant/BlockVine are Material.vine, BlockSnow (id 78) is Material.snow, BlockSnowBlock (id 80) is Material.craftedSnow and BlockGrass (id 2) is Material.grass, neither of which is replaceable. The membership is a one-to-one mirror of the flat list, not an extension of it.
_provenance.climbable_note: The flat climbable list is vanilla's #minecraft:climbable tag, verbatim. That tag is a DATA file in the shipped server jar, so it is read rather than inferred: data/minecraft/tags/blocks/climbable.json in 1.16.1 and 1.16.5 lists ladder, vine, scaffolding, weeping_vines, weeping_vines_plant, twisting_vines, twisting_vines_plant; the same file in 1.17.1 adds cave_vines and cave_vines_plant, which is the whole of the tag through 26.2 (1.21.11-decompiled net/minecraft/data/tags/VanillaBlockTagsProvider.java:289-300, identical to 1.17.1-decompiled net/minecraft/data/tags/BlockTagsProvider.java:565-576). LivingEntity.onClimbable reads exactly that tag (1.21.11-decompiled LivingEntity.java:1707; 1.17.1-decompiled LivingEntity.java:1428). No era switch is needed here because the list is intersected with each version's own block table: nether vines resolve only on 1.16+ (protocol 735+), cave vines only on 1.17+ (755+), and both were climbable from the tick they existed. Defect #82.
